raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The line chart depicts the percentage of employment rates over time, with the x-axis representing age and the y-axis representing employment rate percentage. The x-axis ranges from 20 to 70, with age intervals of 10, and the y-axis ranges from 0 to 100, with intervals of 20. There are three lines representing different groups: 'ohne Migrationshintergrund' (without migration background), 'in Deutschland geboren' (born in Germany), and 'zugewandert bis 2009' (migrated until 2009) and 'zugewandert seit 2010' (migrated since 2010). The 'ohne Migrationshintergrund' line starts at around 60% and peaks at around 80% before declining sharply to 0%. The 'in Deutschland geboren' line starts at around 40%, peaks at around 80%, and then declines to around 20%. The 'zugewandert bis 2009' line starts at around 20%, peaks at around 60%, and then declines to around 0%. The 'zugewandert seit 2010' line starts at around 20%, peaks at around 40%, and then declines to around 0%. All lines show a peak around the age of 50 before declining.
